subject: honey possum
title: This Mammal Eats Only Flowers, and Its Newborn Weighs a Few Milligrams

scenes.text: This mammal has never eaten anything but flowers.
The honey possum of Western Australia weighs about as much as three sugar cubes.
It's the only land mammal that lives entirely on nectar and pollen.
A brush-tipped tongue as long as its head sweeps pollen out of each bloom.
Every day it eats almost its own body weight, flower by flower.
And its babies are born weighing a few thousandths of a gram, among the smallest newborns of any mammal.

description:
The honey possum is the only non-flying mammal that feeds exclusively on nectar and pollen.
Adults weigh roughly 6 to 18 grams, eat almost their body weight a day with a brush-tipped tongue, and their newborns weigh only a few milligrams.
What would you eat if you could only pick one food?
first_comment: Bonus fact: male honey possums make the longest sperm of any mammal. Had you ever heard of this animal?
